items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to write a memorial in a book and rehearse it orally to Joshua

items.quote: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven
items.claim: The LORD will completely erase all remembrance of Amalek from the world
